title: Express vs Node.js

tableData.title: Node.js vs Express
rows: Steeper, requires understanding raw streams and HTTP internals.
Minimal. Provides utilities but no rigid structure.

definition: Node.js is the underlying runtime environment that allows JavaScript to run on a server. Express is a framework built *on top* of Node.js to make writing servers easier. You don't *need* Express to build a Node API, but doing it with raw Node requires writing a lot of messy boilerplate code just to handle simple things like URL routing or JSON parsing.
